mapper.select: SELECT room_resv_num AS roomResvNum, user_mail AS userMail, admin_idx AS adminIdx, room_idx AS roomIdx, resv_num AS resvNum, plan_idx AS planIdx, resv_check_in AS resvCheckIn, resv_check_out AS resvCheckOut, resv_price AS resvPrice, resv_people AS resvPeople, resv_status AS resvStatus, resv_pay_status AS resvPayStatus, resv_pay_method AS resvPayMethod FROM "ROOM_RESERVATION" WHERE resv_check_in < #{rangeEnd} AND resv_check_out > #{rangeStart}
